title: Percentages and fraction conversions: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: What is 7/12 expressed as a percentage, correct to two decimal places?
Find the value of 15% of 360 minus 7.5% of 480.
The price of a phone falls from ₹12,500 to ₹10,500. What is the percentage decrease?
Kavya spends 65% of her monthly salary and has ₹14,700 left. What is her monthly salary (in ₹)?
Rahul's salary is 37.5% less than Sameer's. By what percent is Sameer's salary more than Rahul's?
The length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and its breadth is reduced by 10%. What is the percentage change in its area?
In a survey of 800 households, 62% own a two-wheeler, 45% own a car and 18% own both. How many households own neither?
Ravi spends 3/8 of his income on rent and 2/5 of what remains on food. What percentage of his income is left?
The price of sugar rises by 25%. By what percent must a family cut its consumption so that its spending on sugar rises by only 10%?

In an election between two candidates, 8% of the voters on the list did not vote and 4% of the votes cast were invalid. The winner got 55% of the valid votes and won by 4,416 votes. How many voters were on the list?
